description: This file contains an extension for the CronSettings class, providing helper methods for scheduling, status display, and job selection within the application's codebase.

classes.name: CronSettings
classes.description: An existing class extended with helper methods for scheduling and status display.

methods.name: selectedJob
methods.description: Returns the currently selected CronJob based on the selectedJobId in the store.

methods.name: statusTint
methods.description: Returns a Color indicating the status, based on a given status string.

methods.name: scheduleSummary
methods.description: Produces a human-readable summary of a CronSchedule object.

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration given in milliseconds into a concise string.

methods.name: nextRunLabel
methods.description: Returns a label indicating the time until a scheduled date, such as 'due', 'in 5m', etc.
